name: Belter
description: A woman in her forties who sings power ballads, with commanding performance energy.
build: A trim, athletic, braced build: a firm torso, a defined waist, trim hips and thighs, lean and fit, with the weight carried low over slightly flexed knees.
face: Warm tan skin, dark brown eyes under straight auburn brows, a straight nose, defined cheekbones, faint lines at the outer eye corners, and full lips in deep berry red.
hair: A large mass of thick wavy auburn hair worn completely loose and down, every strand falling free from the scalp: a high crown, wide side volume and ends past the shoulders, the whole mass visibly wider than her shoulders.
outfit: A structured crimson performance jacket with angular lapels, worn open over a fitted charcoal top; high-waisted blue mom jeans with a crimson sash at the waist; chunky ankle boots in near-black dark brown leather, laced with thick warm mid-brown laces. No hat or headwear.
performance_style: Planted: feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft, torso braced over a low centre. The mic held upright at the collarbone, the free character-left hand open at hip height, clear of the jacket. Chin level, a confident closed-mouth smile.
location: A mid-size rock club, seen from the front of a low black stage: a scuffed matte-black deck running to the bottom of the frame, a bare red-brick back wall with a half-furled black drape at one side, a stack of road cases and a silent cabinet amp pushed against it, and a truss of warm PAR cans overhead throwing crossed pools of red and amber onto the brick.
recognition_cues: a wavy auburn hair mass visibly wider than her shoulders
a crimson jacket open over blue jeans
avoid: hair gathered back into a ponytail, bun, twist or clip
a heavy, thickset or broad-hipped build
laces in the same brown as the boot leather

sing.intent: Power-ballad vocal loop: brace through the legs, bring the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth for a sustained phrase, make one compact emphasis with the open character-left hand, then settle back to planted with the mic at the collarbone. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound surprise: the shoulders and hair lift, the torso draws back slightly and both open hands rise to chest height, then she settles back to planted with the knees soft. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: lower into a compact braced stance, bring the character-left forearm across the torso with the character-right hand closed at the hip, then hold a stable grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: step in with low confident weight, square the crimson jacket to the front, then land planted with the feet shoulder-width apart and both hands open at the hips.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: plant both boots, raise the open character-left hand high and lift the chin into a wide open-mouthed smile, let the hair settle, then hold a proud balanced pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: she stays on her feet while the braced stance goes slack — the shoulders drop, both hands open and fall to her sides, and her head hangs low with the chin toward her chest. She holds a standing, visibly crushed finish. The wavy auburn hair mass stays wider than her shoulders as it falls forward. She remains standing on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
